items.text: A lattice calculation of light hadron masses from three inputs, two quark masses and one coupling, agrees with masses a field measures, about 95 percent of a nucleon's mass from "confined energy", its authors' words, and ATLAS and CMS observe a boson at about 125 to 126 GeV, 4 July 2012, a field's account having elementary particles' mass from their interaction with a field, a dynamical property and not an intrinsic one: mass a coupling's, the proposal's mass as a ghost.

Two single-aluminium-ion optical clocks, one 33 cm higher, tick at different rates, and an ion's motion of about 10 m/s shifts its rate, the better clock's systematic uncertainty 8.6 × 10⁻¹⁸: rate going with place and motion at an everyday height, no rate all clocks share.

Gravitational waves from a neutron-star merger and its gamma rays arrive 1.74 ± 0.05 s apart, a field constraining the two speeds to differ by less than −3 × 10⁻¹⁵ to +7 × 10⁻¹⁶ of light's: gravity's changing going at light's rate across sparse space, a pattern match with the proposal's light-prime rate, and gravity as no force cohering with a strain of geometry a field measures.

Alpha particles at a thin gold foil, 1909, about one in a few thousand scattering past 90 degrees, Rutherford in 1911 reading a large positive charge in a very small space at each atom's centre, about 1/100,000 of the atom's size: a concern for a nucleus as only a living corus while a parity lives, its breaking still to say.

Uranium ore from Oklo in Gabon shows 0.717 percent uranium-235 against the usual 0.720 percent, sixteen reactor zones at Oklo fissioning intermittently about 1.7 to 2 billion years ago over some 150,000 years in one estimate, about thirty fission products and neodymium isotopes matching uranium-235's fission in the rock: a concern for no nucleus with no living parity, what living parity includes at a rock two billion years ago still to say.

In narrow quantum wires at about 0.1 K, electrons tunneling in go as two, spinons with magnetism and holons with charge, read from tunneling against a magnetic field: an electron's charge and magnetism going apart in a coupling, the proposal's electron as no possibly existing thing.

Muon neutrinos from below fewer than from above in 50,000 tons of water, 1998; muon and tau neutrinos from the Sun at over 5σ in 1,000 tons of heavy water, the total flux matching a solar model; electron-neutrino signals going and coming again with energy and distance: a changing and changing back at a subatomic scale, a field reading it as neutrinos having mass.

A proposal has a nucleus only the living corus between possibling and same while a parity is living, and no nucleus with no living parity: this entry's radius going with the probe meets it, and a gold foil's scattering, Oklo's fission products and carbon-14 in the air are concerns, its breaking still to say, what living parity includes at a foil between observings and at a rock two billion years ago.

Mass as an entry: a use installing mass as a thing's own, the same through each coupling, binding and decomposition, a ghost; a nucleon's mass about 95 percent from a confinement's energy, elementary masses from an interaction, and binding parting atomic masses from whole daltons a field's own records; its ghost-form breaking a mass belonging to a thing with no coupling.

Gravity as an entry beside Natural Physics 4.2: a use installing gravity as a force a body has, issuing from a centre, a ghost; a falling body on a geodesic with no force and gravity's changing at light's rate a field's own records; its ghost-form breaking a force a falling body feels.
